description: Dopravné objekty is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.sk. The Transport Objects (DO) dataset is part of one of the ZBGIS categories called Anthropogenic Elements-Culture (AP-K). The DO dataset contains semi-written objects created by human activities in the field of transport and objects necessary for its operation. Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Transport objects" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include závora, vlek, Priepust, Chodník, Doprava, Dopravné objekty. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2021-12-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
